Effect: Closest visible enemy within 15" is hit (Rend -1, Damage d3).
A visible friendly fighter within 6" has one melee weapon ignited until end of round: it gains the Arcane trait and Rend improves by 1.

Two points (within 9" of caster, 6" of each other, same elevation) form a barrier until end of round or caster taken down: -1 to ranged attack rolls across it; fighters activating in or crossing it take d3 damage.
Critical Cast Effect: The two points can be up to 9" apart instead of 6".

Effect: A visible enemy Wizard or Priest within 12" cannot make arcane actions until end of round.
Flame template: each fighter in the area is hit (Rend -1, Damage d3+1).

Blast template placed within 15" and scatters d6"; fighters in it are hit (Rend -1, Damage d3+1). The template stays as a vortex until end of round: it blocks line of sight on the same elevation and hits fighters that start in it or cross it.
A visible friendly fighter within 15" heals d3 life.
A visible friendly fighter within 9" adds 1 to hit rolls for melee attacks until end of round.
Critical Cast Effect: Up to 2 friendly fighters can be picked.

Effect: Until end of round, a 9" aura: friendly fighters beginning a move in it add 1" to their maximum move.
A visible friendly fighter within 15" improves Armour by 1 (maximum 2+) until end of round.
Critical Cast Effect: Up to 2 friendly fighters can be picked. (Book prints the crit value as '1o+'; read as 10+.)

Effect: Until end of round, a 6" aura: friendly fighters' melee weapons add 1 to Critical Damage while inside it.

A point on the floor within 12": friendly fighters within 3" improve Armour by 1. It stays in play; caster must pass a Willpower test at the start of each activation or it ends. Recasting ends the old instance; it ends if caster is taken down.
A visible friendly fighter within 3" (or the caster) is removed and set up again within 9" of the caster, not engaged in melee.
A visible enemy fighter within 12" is doomed: you can make them re-roll one attack, parry or armour roll, after which they are no longer doomed.
Closest visible enemy within 12" is hit (Rend -1, Damage d3), then another enemy within 3" of it and visible to it is hit with the same attack.
Critical Cast Effect: A third enemy within 3" of the first two is also hit.

Effect: Blast template placed on the floor within 12" and scattered d6"; d3 friendly fighters in Reserve are set up on the floor in the template, not engaged in melee.
Until end of round, a 6" aura: friendly fighters inside are in cover.
Blast template within 15", scatters d6"; fighters in it are hit (Rend -1, Damage d3). It then scatters d6" again and hits fighters there with the same attack (a fighter can be hit twice).
Critical Cast Effect: The first placement does not scatter.

Effect: Flame template from the caster: each fighter in it is hit (Rend -1, Damage 1).
A friendly fighter within 6" has one melee weapon fetid until end of round: it gains the Arcane and Poison traits.
Until end of round, a 6" aura: friendly fighters inside add 1 to melee attack rolls.
A visible enemy fighter within 18" has Armour worsened by 1 (minimum '-') for the rest of the round.
Critical Cast Effect: Lasts for the rest of the battle.

Effect: Each friendly fighter within 3" of the caster heals 1 life.
Blast template within 12" of a visible point, scatters d6"; fighters in it are hit (no Rend, Damage d3) and become poisoned.
Place d3 witchfire tokens by the caster (maximum 3). Once per activation the caster can spend a token for a bonus action: closest visible enemy within 12" is hit (no Rend, Damage d3).
A visible friendly fighter within 6" improves Armour by 1 (maximum 2+) until end of round.
A summoned Zombie is added to the caster's warband until taken down, set up within 3" of the caster and not engaged. A warband can have at most 3 summoned fighters; at 3 the spell cannot be cast.
Critical Cast Effect: Can be set up within 9" of the caster.

Effect: Another visible friendly fighter within 6" is removed and set up again within 15" of the caster, not engaged in melee.
Blast template within 12" scatters d6"; fighters in it are hit (Rend -1, Damage d3+1).
Flame template from the caster: each fighter in it is hit (Rend -2, Damage d3).
Closest visible enemy within 9" suffers 1 damage and the caster heals 1 life.
Critical Cast Effect: Target suffers 2 damage and the caster heals 2.

Effect: A friendly fighter within 6" has one melee weapon cursed until end of round: it gains the Arcane and Poison traits.

A summoned Skeleton (with Cuirass, Shield and a Club, Spear or Sword) is added to the caster's warband until taken down, set up within 3" of the caster and not engaged. At most 3 summoned fighters per warband.
Critical Cast Effect: Can be set up within 9" of the caster.

Effect: A friendly Thrall on the battlefield is removed and set up again within 3" of the caster, not engaged in melee.
Critical Cast Effect: Up to 2 friendly Thralls can be picked.

Effect: Flame template from the caster: each fighter in it suffers 1 damage and must pass a Willpower test or be disorientated (-1 to Attack and Parry rolls) until end of round.
Critical Cast Effect: Targeted fighters take their Willpower tests at -1.

Effect: A line 12" long and 1" wide from the caster: each visible enemy it crosses is hit (Rend -2, Damage d3). The caster heals 1 life per point of damage dealt.
A visible friendly fighter within 9" ignores the first 3 points of damage it suffers until end of round.
A point on the floor within 6": until end of round the floor within 6" of it is a mire. Non-Cloister fighters moving across it lose 2" of maximum move.
Closest visible enemy within 9" suffers d3 damage; if not taken down it must pass a Willpower test or scatter d6".
Blast template within 12" scatters d6"; each fighter in it heals d3 life.
A friendly fighter within 6" has its melee weapons gain the Arcane and Poison traits until end of round.
Flame template from the caster: each fighter in it is hit (Rend -1, Damage d3).
Critical Cast Effect: Each fighter hit must pass a Willpower test or be poisoned.

Effect: A summoned Rotling is added to the caster's warband until taken down, set up within 3" of the caster and not engaged. At most 3 summoned fighters per warband.
Critical Cast Effect: Can be set up within 9" of the caster.

Effect: A friendly Demon or Beastman within 6" adds 1 to Damage and Critical Damage of its melee weapons until end of round.
Critical Cast Effect: Up to 2 fighters can be picked.

Effect: Closest visible enemy within 9" suffers 1 damage; if not taken down its Move becomes 2" until it passes a Willpower test at the end of one of its activations.
Blast template within 15": each enemy fighter in it must pass a Willpower test or become poisoned.
Critical Cast Effect: Willpower tests for this spell are made at -1.

Effect: A friendly Demon or Beastman within 6" improves Armour by 1 until end of round.

Blast template on the floor within 9": a pit opens until end of round. Fighters in it are moved to its edge and must pass an Initiative test or suffer d3 damage and be poisoned; the pit blocks movement on the floor and destroys treasure tokens on it.
